title: A Plague of Rats
description: Rats overrun the sewers beneath Britain. Slay five of them and return to me, and you will be paid.
refuse: Then the sewers will keep their tenants a while longer.
uncomplete: The rats are still down there, friend. Five of them.
complete: The sewers will rest easier tonight. Here — you have earned this.

title: An Escort Request
description: I must travel, and the roads are not safe alone. Lead me there and you will be paid for your trouble.
refuse: Then I shall wait for a braver soul.
uncomplete: We are not there yet. Lead on.
complete: We have arrived safely — my thanks, and your pay.

title: Silk for the Spellwright
description: Bring me five skeins of spiders' silk and you'll be paid. The mage by the bank sells it.
refuse: As you like. The silk will not gather itself.
uncomplete: Five skeins, no fewer. Come back when you have them.
complete: Fine silk — my thanks. Here is your pay.
